title: The puddle, frozen
logline: The alley's puddle frozen solid, the beer sign's neon locked in it, the pup at twelve stepping onto the ice and standing. The Rain's puddle in its last January, holding still.

panels.composition: A gravel alley at night with the beer sign's neon reflected in a puddle frozen solid, an old three-legged dog standing carefully on the ice.
